claims.description: A distinct authenticated-adult ceremony consumes a signed, short-lived VPC assertion bound to the server-resolved caller and credentialed learner. It re-resolves current country policy and exact age/residence facts, requires an adult with verified-credential age evidence, and rejects wrong-adult, minor-caller, residence/policy drift, joint-consent without learner assent, multiple/different active guardians, stale/withdrawn/restored grants, and mismatched evidence.

The approved authority assertion is HMAC-authenticated with a domain-separated, production-required secret and carries jurisdiction, policy version, assurance method, tokenised evidence id, qualification, decision, learner assent and expiry. Pending, denied, expired, malformed, tampered and wrong-secret assertions fail closed.

The transaction takes a charge-scoped advisory lock, creates or confirms the global Guardianship edge, and writes both independently auditable consent purposes with jurisdiction, policy, method, evidence, age and authorization-form stamps. A forced post-edge failure proves rollback leaves neither edge nor grants. The flow never writes Supportership and never mutates the learner Person/Login binding.

Real-database coverage proves learning consent is PENDING before attachment and CONSENTED only after both stamped grants exist; exact retry confirms without duplicates; wrong adult, changed residence, withdrawal, legacy restore, minor caller and a different existing valid guardian remain fail closed.
The existing family-invite integration contract remains unchanged and independently proves accepting an inviter-issued family invite creates no Guardianship edge; invitation alone is never authority.

The shared strict request/result contract exposes only learner id plus opaque assertion to mobile. The mutation disables retries for authority rejection and invalidates the consent/learning access projections after success; mobile tests exercise the real Hono client boundary and a 403 fail-closed response.

Broad verification is green: API/schema/mobile TypeScript builds, focused API token and production-config unit suites, focused mobile suite, the disposable-local-PostgreSQL integration suite, repository prepush, and repository-wide lint with no errors.
